diagnosis: The team roster route applies fastapi-cache with a custom key builder that only hashes request.url.path and query_params. Because user.organization_id is absent from the cache key, the first organization that calls /organization/team-roster populates the cache for all other organizations, leaking employee email addresses, phone numbers, and roles to other tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /organization/team-roster HTTP/1.1
Host: hr.workplace-central.com
Authorization: Bearer <unrelated_org_jwt>
